Implemented HHH-11931 with a two-line JPA classifier correction. Non-primitive attributes retain their declared TypeMirror, and the Comparable predicate requires strict subtyping instead of unchecked assignment compatibility. Raw Comparable attributes now use SingularAttribute without losing their value type. Valid parameterized self-comparable values, comparable-supertype inheritance and existing specializations remain intact. DataMetaAttributeGenerationVisitor is unchanged because its Comparable and Temporal bounds differ; this does not claim that every Data bound differs or that its classifier is fully validated.
